title: XOR changes which pairs combine
hook: Changing the way indices combine changes the transform you need.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary masks, basic complex arithmetic for FFT, polynomial coefficients.
doesNotKnow: Compute XOR convolution with sum/difference transforms rather than ordinary polynomial convolution.

misconception: Ordinary convolution also handles indices combined with XOR.
objective: Compute XOR convolution with sum/difference transforms rather than ordinary polynomial convolution.

claims.text: The sum/difference basis turns XOR-index pairing into pointwise multiplication. Applying the transform again and dividing by the length returns sums over i XOR j=k. Ordinary polynomial convolution groups by i+j instead, so it computes a different operation.
